definitions.explanation: Something of great value or worth, either literally (gold, jewels) or figuratively (precious memories, beloved person).

examples.japanese: {海賊|かいぞく}が{宝|たから}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: The pirates are searching for treasure.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}は{私|わたし}の{宝|たから}です。
{宝|たから}の{持|も}ち{腐|ぐさ}れ。
examples.english: A pearl cast before swine. (Having treasure but not using it)

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {宝物|たからもの} (treasure, prized possession)
- {宝箱|たからばこ} (treasure chest)
- {宝探|たからさが}し (treasure hunt)
- {宝くじ|たからくじ} (lottery)
- {宝石|ほうせき} (jewel, gem)

PROVERB:
- {宝|たから}の{持|も}ち{腐|ぐさ}れ: Having valuable things but failing to use them; letting talent or resources go to waste.

CULTURAL NOTE: The Seven Lucky Gods ({七福神|しちふくじん}) are often depicted with their treasure ship ({宝船|たからぶね}).
